title: Serve
intro: We believe Christian faith is lived out through practical care for our neighbors and our community.

sections.heading: Bell Tower Treasures
sections.text: Bell Tower Treasures is a small store in the church where donated gently used items are sold. All proceeds go back into the community. The store is normally open the 2nd Saturday of the month. See the Events Page for details.

sections.heading: Laundry Love
sections.text: Laundry Love helps neighbors with the practical cost of washing and drying clothes. This ministry is one way Epiphany meets people with dignity and care. We do this the first Saturday of every month. Check the Events page for details.

sections.heading: Blood Drive
sections.text: Our parish hosts a community blood drive and invites neighbors, friends, and members to take part in a simple act that can save lives.

sections.heading: Back to School Bash
sections.text: Every year we collect school supplies and give them to students. We have a large event at the church for the students and give everyone a nice lunch.
